reviews.title: Asiahorse is the best
reviews.comment: Absolutely best fans on the market at the price point, especially being on sale with a coupon 99% of the time. I’ve bought asiahorse for years and they never fail to amaze me, incredibly quiet, cool, and sleek. They have great customer service as well which should be a huge plus for anyone that’s on the fence about trying them out. Will continue to buy and always will recommend
reviews.author: Daniel Wilson

reviews.title: Well worth it!
reviews.comment: Fast, great airflow, the ARGB is excellent, the only gripe, and it's a small one is they can be a bit loud when pushed
reviews.author: James D.

reviews.title: My opinion
reviews.comment: I love these fans, very quiet and great air flow. Just dont like that when I turn it to a purple or a light blue color it flashes like crazy like it cant be a solid color unless it blue,green,red. And I hate that I have to go in the bios to control fan speed. Also love that you can daisy chain the wires makes it so much easier
reviews.author: Dalton K Tusing
